verses.text: Since you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
You died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you too will appear with him in glory.
So put to death whatever belongs to your earthly nature: sexual sin, impure living, lust, evil desires and greed. Greed is the same as worshipping idols.
Because of these things, God's anger is coming on those who disobey him.
You used to live that way, in the life you once lived.
But now you must get rid of all these things: anger, rage, spite, evil talk, and dirty language from your lips.
Do not lie to each other. You have taken off your old self with its ways,
and you have put on the new self. It is being made new in knowledge, to be like its Creator.
Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, foreigner, wild outsider, slave or free. But Christ is all, and he is in all.
You are God's chosen people, holy and dearly loved. So clothe yourselves with tender care, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.
Put up with each other. If any of you has a complaint against someone, forgive them. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
Above all these, put on love. It binds everything together perfectly.
Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts. You were called to peace as members of one body. And be thankful.
Let the message of Christ live in you richly. Teach and warn one another with all wisdom. Sing psalms, hymns and songs from the Spirit, with thanks to God in your hearts.
Whatever you do, in word or action, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus. Give thanks to God the Father through him.
Wives, put your husbands first, as is right in the Lord.
Husbands, love your wives, and do not be harsh with them.
Children, obey your parents in everything, because this pleases the Lord.
Fathers, do not make your children bitter, or they will lose heart.
Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything. Do it not only when they are watching, to win their favour. Do it with an honest heart, out of respect for the Lord.
Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as if working for the Lord, not for people.
You know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
Anyone who does wrong will be paid back for the wrong he has done. God treats everyone the same.
